corpus: synthetic-capacity.v1; 8 provenance fields per spot; unknown hours and type support
environment: macOS, disk-backed node:sqlite for pipeline; actual local wrangler workerd for HTTP; no remote DB, production mutation or Apple changes

methodology.viewport: cold current-client v1→409→manifest→parts; 404 costs a request; gzip payload bytes exclude problem bodies/headers/config
methodology.sparse: uniform archipelago bounding rectangle 24–45.5N,123–146E, including water; synthetic spatial stress, not land coverage or actual smoking-place distribution
methodology.extreme: all spots inside one z14 tile, 0.006-degree jitter
